subject: Vendor onboarding: NovoMarket — VAT classification & PO activation
messages:
From: Marina Costa <marina@novomarket.pt>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@novomarket.pt>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: NovoMarket vendor setup — VAT and PO questions

Hi Jordan / Redwood team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process — I’m Marina from NovoMarket finance. A few items we need clarified so our AP can flow invoices against Redwood POs without delays:

- Our entity: NovoMarket Portugal, VAT PT987654321. We are not registered for VAT in other EU countries. Do you need a Portuguese fiscal representative for Redwood to process POs?
- Does Redwood prefer the supplier VAT to be listed as the billing VAT or should we put “reverse charge” on lines where the service is supplied?
- PO requirements: do you require the PO number on the invoice header and on each line item? Does Redwood have a preferred PO template / cost-center mapping?
- Currency: we plan to invoice in EUR. Any currency conversion notes?

I’ve attached a sample invoice and our standard supplier form. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Attachments: sample-invoice_Novomarket.pdf; supplier-form.pdf

Regards,
Marina Costa
Head of Finance — NovoMarket
marina@novomarket.pt
+351 21 555 1234
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marina Costa <marina@novomarket.pt>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovoMarket vendor setup — VAT and PO questions

Hi Marina — thanks for the details and the sample invoice. Short answers first, then next steps.

1) Fiscal representative: not required for a Portugal-registered supplier if the invoice shows a valid PT VAT (PT987654321) and the supply is to Redwood’s EU purchasing entity. We only ask for a fiscal representative when the supplier is non-resident in the EU or when local filing obligations are triggered.

2) Reverse charge vs supplier VAT: please mark the invoice with either (a) your VAT details and the VAT amount when you are charging VAT, or (b) the legend "reverse charge — Article 196 VAT Directive" when the supply is subject to reverse charge and you are not charging VAT. For services supplied cross-border to our EU entity, we usually apply reverse charge — we will confirm after we map the account to the correct legal entity.

3) PO requirements: we require the Redwood PO number on the invoice header and on each line where possible. We also need the PO to reference the cost center (e.g., ENG-PLATFORM or MARKETING-EU) so AP can route automatically. I attached our small PO template (PO-template_EU_v1.xlsx) — it’s optional but helps with automated matching.

4) Currency: EUR invoices are fine. Our finance system will record the invoice in EUR and perform the conversion to USD at payment time if necessary; please include your bank IBAN and SWIFT.

Next steps for you (3 items):
- Upload a signed supplier form to our vendor portal (I’ve created an SSO invite — see attached portal invite).
- Upload a clear VAT certificate (copy of VAT registration / VIES screenshot) to the portal.
- Update the invoice to include the PO number and cost center when we issue the PO.

I’m looping in Laura (payments / AP process) and Ben (tax intake) below — they’ll confirm any edge cases. If you prefer a 20-minute call to walk through the portal, I’m available Tue/Wed morning CET.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Procurement — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marina Costa <marina@novomarket.pt>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovoMarket vendor setup — VAT and PO questions

Adding a quick tax note: if NovoMarket provides digital marketing services to Redwood’s EU legal entity, reverse-charge will usually apply. Please ensure the invoice does not include Portuguese VAT in that case and add the phrase "reverse charge — intra-community supply / Article 196" plus your VAT number.

If you do charge VAT (e.g., local taxable place), we’ll need a VAT invoice with VAT broken out and a VAT registration proof.

Also: when you upload the VAT certificate, include the VIES lookup screenshot (date-stamped). That speeds validation.

—Ben
Senior Tax Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Marina Costa <marina@novomarket.pt>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@novomarket.pt>

Thanks Jordan / Ben — that’s clear and helpful.

We’ll: 1) sign and upload the supplier form to the portal today, 2) attach a VIES screenshot and a copy of our VAT certificate, and 3) wait for the PO from Redwood before issuing the invoice.

One quick question — for the PO template cost-center mapping, can you confirm Redwood’s expected format? Is it the full name (e.g., Engineering — Platform) or the short code (ENG-PLATFORM)? We’ll map both if you prefer.

I’ve attached the sample invoice (sample-invoice_Novomarket.pdf) again and our supplier form for reference.

Regards,
Marina
